conditional_scenario.assumptions: If Jacoby Brissett starts for BAL and Carolina Panthers stays at baseline-embedded QB production. conditional_scenario.uncertainty: Coefficient-only bootstrap interval. Partial uncertainty: excludes uncertainty in starter quality (posterior_sd), embedded-proxy error, role/starter uncertainty and selection/confounding. Not a full predictive interval. Association, not causal injury effect. QB rushing and non-QB injuries excluded.
